newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Militant Shi'ite leader shot dead in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Militant Shi'ite leader shot dead in Pakistan.

text.p: Gunmen killed a leader of a militant Shi'ite Moslem group in the Pakistani town of Bahawalpur on Monday, hours after 21 Sunni Moslems died in an attack on a mosque in a nearby city, Shi'ite sources said.
They said two gunmen on a motorcyle shot Mumtaz-ul-Hassan, president of the local branch of the Shi'ite Tehrik-i-Jafria Pakistan movement, while he was on his way to evening prayers.
The killing appeared to have been a reprisal for a dawn attack on a Sunni mosque in Multan city, 95 km (60 miles) north of Bahawalpur, in which 21 people were killed.
That attack, in turn, may have been revenge for the Sunday night killing of another militant Shi'ite leader in Bahawalpur.
Hardline Sunni and Shi'ite groups have long waged a bloody feud in Pakistan, whose mainly Sunni population of 130 million has a Shi'ite minority of about 15 percent.
